name: M.P. Evans Group PLC
summary: M.P. Evans Group PLC, through its subsidiaries, owns and develops oil palm plantations in Indonesia and Malaysia. The company operates through Plantation and Property segments. It produces and sells crude palm oil and palm kernels. The company is also involved in the property development; and oil-palm fresh fruit bunches production businesses, as well as provision of agronomic and management consultancy services. In addition, it manages smallholder oil palms. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Tunbridge Wells, the United Kingdom.
